title: Order of Isis Marshal Poker Run
venueAddress: Starts at The Piano Bar, continues to Hayley's Bar, and ends at Stables Bar
description: A bar crawl fundraiser starting at The Piano Bar, moving to Hayley's Bar, and ending at Stables Bar. Best 5-card poker hand wins cash. $20 entry with a buy-back option at the final stop.
